axis_convention.origin: RGB-aligned metric 3D point at a foreground pixel selected inside the instance mask near the trimmed longitudinal midpoint
axis_convention.positive_y: from the handle or proximal end toward the working tip
axis_convention.positive_z: support-plane normal toward free space and approximately toward CAM4

classes.initial_sign_estimator: larger longitudinal end mass is the handle

classes.name: Mosquito
classes.initial_sign_estimator: larger longitudinal end mass is the handle

classes.name: Adson Forceps
classes.initial_sign_estimator: first classify the whole-mask placement: an approximately linear and monotonically widening triangular silhouette uses its wider end as the working tip even when the jaw gap is faint; non-triangular or slender layouts then use separated-jaw evidence followed by terminal taper; ambiguous masks use the smaller terminal mass with low-confidence status

classes.name: Bipolar Forceps
classes.initial_sign_estimator: a non-hierarchical signed-vote ensemble combines connector taper (0.45), black-handle/blue-tip colour agreement (0.40 when available), and terminal mass (0.15); a single detected colour cue is down-weighted; external wire geometry remains excluded; low ensemble confidence is reported instead of forcing a reliable sign

classes.name: Bovie
classes.initial_sign_estimator: larger longitudinal end mass is the handle

classes.name: Army-Navy Retractor
classes.initial_sign_estimator: negative projected CAM4 x; negative projected CAM4 y as tie-break
classes.note: Both ends are working blades; the sign is a deterministic CAM4 representative convention.

classes.name: Thyroid Retractor
classes.initial_sign_estimator: larger longitudinal end mass is the handle

invalidity_policy: The instance origin pixel must be inside that instance mask; a bbox center, mask hole, or background pixel is forbidden.
The instance position is expressed in meters in cam_4_color_optical_frame, never as a normalized 0-to-1 image coordinate.
Do not publish a valid planar orientation when the instance is not supported by the fitted Mayo surface.
Do not fabricate metric position when registered depth or the support plane is invalid.
Mark low endpoint-sign confidence instead of silently treating it as reliable.
Historical 0704 RGB-depth recovery is provisional until official synchronization and factory extrinsic are supplied.
